module: Flowgraph node "Comment" (category logic, tag group, no pins). Places a comment in the graph, as a resizable group frame that can visually group nodes. Editable properties: title, text (2048 characters max), alpha, background/border/text colors, "Simple" mode (no group, just text) and move mode (With Nodes: the nodes inside move with the frame; Without Nodes). Editor only, no effect at runtime. Serializes size, colors, alpha, title, text (line breaks are escaped as \n), simple and moveMode.
notes: In _onDeserialized, the test to load borderColor checks nodeData.backgroundColor (not borderColor): crashes if borderColor is absent while backgroundColor exists.
drawCustomProperties calls dump(self.te) if a text editor exists, but self.te is never created (commented-out code).

init.desc: Initializes size 200x200, title "Comment", colors (background gray 0.5, border 0.8, text white), alpha 0.75, moveMode 'withoutNodes', simple false.

showProperties.desc: Called when the properties panel opens; no effect (commented-out code).

hideProperties.desc: Called when the properties panel closes; no effect (commented-out code).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the properties panel (title, alpha, colors, simple, move mode, text) and returns the change reason for the undo history.

refreshColors.desc: Recomputes the background, border and text ImVec4 from the float arrays.

_onSerialize.desc: Adds the comment-specific fields to the result.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the fields from the loaded data.

updateEditorPosition.desc: Repositions the node in the editor when the manager opens (if the position is within valid bounds) and forces the size.

draw.desc: Draws the frame, the title, the resizable group and the group hint in the editor.
